At any time, wherever you are, this app offers you the full Voyage Privé experience:
- A hundred offers selected and negotiated from the best hotels in the world
- Personalised alerts so you don't miss the trip of your dreams
- Secure payment to book your vacation with confidence
- Refer your friends and receive vouchers when they register

WHO ARE WE?

The leading private travel sales website, voyageprive.com offers its 7 million members a selection of top-of-the-range trips every day at exclusive prices, with discounts of up to 70%. These offers are valid for a limited time in the form of a flash sale.

Not a Voyage Privé member yet? Join us for free and without obligation, directly from the app.
